headline: 今日AI速览：学术研究最活跃
narrative:
今日共收录247篇AI新闻，分类分布：学术研究171篇, 开源项目39篇, 模型发布37篇。热门标签：Agent（52篇）。其中13%的文章有多来源交叉验证。

▸ meta /astryx：An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready

▸ anthropics /skills：Public repository for Agent Skills

▸ addyosmani /agent-skills：Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.

▸ homeassistant-ai /ha-mcp：Configure and automate Home Assistant with Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants.

▸ vercel-labs /agent-browser：Browser automation CLI for AI agents
